Every top college rugby program in America. Mapped.

Rugby Campus is a free guide to the 40 best college rugby programs in the USA, across CRAA D1A and NCR D1. Each program is tiered on results, with coach contacts, conference, squad size, MLR draft picks and campus details. Built by Hugh Johnston, an Australian who played, captained and then coached Notre Dame College to the 2023 NCR D1 National Championship.
